_doc: Grandfather allow-list for no-literal-home-path-lint.mjs (SD-LEO-INFRA-REPO-HYGIENE-PATH-001, FR-1). Keys are repo-relative file paths. Each entry REQUIRES a non-empty reason -- the loader throws loud on any entry missing one. Populated from the full-corpus scan at authoring time (2026-08-24, after fixing HOME_PATH_RE to also match double-backslash-escaped literals as they actually appear on disk in a JS string, e.g. 'C:\\Users\\rickf' -- the single-backslash-only first draft missed the 5 handoff-gate entries below entirely): scripts/one-off/**, scripts/archive/**, tests/**, and session-scratch dirs (.claude/, .artifacts/, .rca/, .logs/, .prd-payloads/) are excluded from the lint's population entirely (not grandfathered) as historical/disposable/non-shipped by convention -- see DIR_ALLOWLIST_RE in the lint script. The entries below are every remaining live-code hit; the 2 highest-blast-radius files named in the PRD (lib/gates/cross-repo-build-check.js, scripts/modules/handoff/executors/exec-to-plan/gates/ui-interactivity-check.js) were retrofitted directly in this same SD instead of grandfathered. A future PR retrofitting one of these files should remove its entry in the SAME commit that adds resolveRepoPath().

allow.scripts/hooks/lib/detect-context.cjs: Pre-existing ENGINEER_ROOT-only fallback literal (process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR || '<literal>') -- narrower blast radius than an 'ehg' venture-repo hardcode (only matters when CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is unset on a machine with a differently-named home directory), but the same anti-pattern class. Not retrofitted in this SD -- only the 2 highest-blast-radius live-gate-code sites named in the PRD were fixed directly; these 4 handoff/hook gate files run on every fleet handoff, and retrofitting them deserves the same due diligence (import-load check, affected-test run) given the 2 named sites, not a rushed edit added mid-lint-authoring. Tracked here as visible, disclosed debt; remove this entry in the same commit that switches this file to resolveRepoPath()/getRepoRoot().
